schema.text: What would make it easier or safer for you to get around on foot or in a wheelchair? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Safer crossings and lower vehicle speeds
Better separation from cyclists and e-scooters
Sidewalks in better condition and better maintained
Longer green time at pedestrian traffic lights
Tactile paving for blind and partially sighted people
Benches and other places to sit and rest
Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past steps and onto pavements
Pavements and paths free of vehicles and other obstacles

it.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: Attraversamenti più sicuri e velocità dei veicoli più basse
it.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Spazi per chi va a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, separati da biciclette e monopattini elettrici
it.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Marciapiedi in condizioni migliori e con più manutenzione
it.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Strade e piazze più pulite e meglio tenute
it.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Più tempo di verde ai semafori pedonali
it.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Percorsi riconoscibili con i piedi o il bastone, per chi non vede o vede poco
it.#Larger, clearer signs: Cartelli più grandi e più chiari
it.#What would make it easier or safer for: Cosa renderebbe più facile o sicuro spostarti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle? (Puoi scegliere più risposte)
it.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Panchine e altri posti per sedersi e riposare
it.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Rampe e marciapiedi con accessi senza gradini
it.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Marciapiedi e percorsi liberi da veicoli e altri ostacoli

fr.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: Des passages plus sûrs et une vitesse des véhicules réduite
fr.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Une meilleure séparation avec les vélos et les trottinettes électriques
fr.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Des trottoirs en meilleur état et mieux entretenus
fr.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Des rues et des places plus propres et mieux entretenues
fr.#Sidewalks where there are none: Des trottoirs là où il n’y en a pas
fr.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Un feu vert plus long aux feux pour piétons
fr.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Bandes podotactiles pour les personnes aveugles et malvoyantes
fr.#Larger, clearer signs: Panneaux plus grands et plus lisibles
fr.#What would make it easier or safer for: Qu’est-ce qui faciliterait ou sécuriserait vos déplacements à pied ou en fauteuil roulant ? (Plusieurs réponses possibles)
fr.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Des bancs et d’autres endroits pour s’asseoir et se reposer
fr.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Des rampes et des bordures abaissées pour accéder aux trottoirs sans marches
fr.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Des trottoirs et des chemins sans véhicules ni autres obstacles

de.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Bessere Trennung von Fahrrädern und E-Scootern
de.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Gehwege in besserem Zustand und besserer Instandhaltung
de.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Sauberere, besser gepflegte Straßen und Plätze
de.#Sidewalks where there are none: Gehwege dort, wo es keine gibt
de.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Taktile Leitsysteme für blinde und sehbehinderte Menschen
de.#What would make it easier or safer for: Was würde Ihre Wege zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl einfacher oder sicherer machen? (Mehrere Antworten möglich)
de.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Bänke und andere Sitzgelegenheiten zum Ausruhen
de.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Rampen und abgesenkte Bordsteine für stufenlose Zugänge zu Gehwegen
de.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Gehwege und Wege ohne Fahrzeuge und andere Hindernisse

tr.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: Daha güvenli geçitler ve daha düşük araç hızları
tr.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Bisikletlerden ve e-scooterlardan daha iyi ayrılmak
tr.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Daha iyi durumda ve daha bakımlı kaldırımlar
tr.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Daha temiz, daha bakımlı sokaklar ve meydanlar
tr.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Yaya ışıklarında daha uzun yeşil süre
tr.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Görme engelli kişiler için hissedilebilir yüzeyler
tr.#Larger, clearer signs: Daha büyük ve daha net tabelalar
tr.#What would make it easier or safer for: Yürüyerek veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ulaşımınızı ne kolaylaştırır ya da daha güvenli hâle getirir? (Birden fazla yanıt seçebilirsiniz)
tr.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Oturup dinlenmek için banklar ve başka yerler
tr.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Basamakları aşmak ve kaldırıma çıkmak için rampalar ve alçaltılmış bordürler
tr.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Araç ve diğer engellerden arındırılmış kaldırımlar ve yollar

fa.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: گذرگاه‌های ایمن‌تر و سرعت کمتر وسایل نقلیه
fa.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: جداسازی بهتر از دوچرخه‌سواران و اسکوترهای برقی
fa.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: پیاده‌روهای بهتر و با نگهداری بهتر
fa.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: خیابان‌ها و میدان‌های تمیزتر و با نگهداری بهتر
fa.#Sidewalks where there are none: پیاده‌رو در جاهایی که وجود ندارد
fa.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: زمان سبز طولانی‌تر در چراغ‌های عابر پیاده
fa.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: مسیرهای لمسی برای افراد نابینا و کم‌بینا
fa.#What would make it easier or safer for: چه چیزی رفت‌وآمد پیاده یا با ویلچر را برای شما آسان‌تر یا امن‌تر می‌کند؟ (می‌توانید چند پاسخ انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Benches and other places to sit and res: نیمکت و جاهای دیگر برای نشستن و استراحت
fa.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: رمپ و جدول کوتاه‌شده برای عبور بدون پله و دسترسی به پیاده‌رو
fa.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: پیاده‌روها و مسیرهای بدون وسیله نقلیه و موانع دیگر

hu.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: Jobb elválasztás a kerékpároktól és az elektromos rollerektől
hu.#Sidewalks in better condition and bette: Jobb állapotú és jobban karbantartott járdák
hu.#Cleaner, better-kept streets and square: Tisztább, jobban karbantartott utcák és terek
hu.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: Hosszabb zöld jelzés a gyalogos lámpáknál
hu.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: Taktilis vezetősávok vak és gyengénlátó emberek számára
hu.#What would make it easier or safer for: Mi tenné könnyebbé vagy biztonságosabbá a gyalogos vagy kerekesszékes közlekedését? (Több válasz is megjelölhető)
hu.#Benches and other places to sit and res: Padok és más ülőhelyek a pihenéshez
hu.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: Rámpák és lesüllyesztett szegélyek a lépcsőmentes járdahasználathoz
hu.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: Járművektől és más akadályoktól mentes járdák és utak

ar.#Safer crossings and lower vehicle speed: معابر أكثر أمانًا وسرعات أقل للمركبات
ar.#Better separation from cyclists and e-s: فصل أفضل عن راكبي الدراجات الهوائية والسكوترات الكهربائية
ar.#Sidewalks where there are none: أرصفة في الأماكن التي لا توجد فيها
ar.#Longer green time at pedestrian traffic: مدة أطول للضوء الأخضر في إشارات المشاة
ar.#Tactile paving for blind and partially: ممرات لمسية للأشخاص المكفوفين وضعاف البصر
ar.#What would make it easier or safer for: ما الذي يجعل التنقل سيرًا على الأقدام أو بالكرسي المتحرك أسهل أو أكثر أمانًا؟ (يمكن اختيار أكثر من إجابة)
ar.#Ramps and dropped kerbs to get past ste: منحدرات وأرصفة منخفضة الحواف لتجاوز الدرج والوصول إلى الرصيف
ar.#Pavements and paths free of vehicles an: أرصفة ومسارات خالية من المركبات والعوائق الأخرى
